description: Canonical field registry for company records (SPEC.md §4a, ADR-017). Company fields keep the company_ prefix so the same fact has the same name whether it appears on a company record or embedded on a person record.

fields.name: company_domain
fields.description: Registrable domain (eTLD+1). Identity tier 1 for companies (SPEC.md §4).

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: Company name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier (SPEC.md §4).

fields.name: company_website
fields.description: Website URL as provided. company_domain is the comparable form.

fields.name: company_employees
fields.description: Headcount as an integer — never a range string.

fields.name: company_industry
fields.description: Industry label. Value domain deferred until a second adapter forces comparability (rule of two).
